resources.string: Receive private alerts without keeping Zapp running
Receive a generic alert when an encrypted direct message may be waiting.
Zapp unsubscribes from its opaque notification topics. Messages synchronize when you next open the app.
Google Play services can deliver a generic alert in Doze without a persistent Zapp service or “running” notification.
What the alert service can observe

FCM can observe this app installation, opaque topic membership, and timing. It receives no identity, contact, message, media, wallet, or conversation-key data. Opening Zapp performs the authentic encrypted sync.
